txt: The agent reads the foundation model’s output as text. The Virtual Lab agents called ESM, AlphaFold-Multimer and Rosetta to refine nanobodies; Paper2Agent packages AlphaGenome as agent tools.
Data are rewritten as language, for example each cell as a list of its top genes.
Embeddings are converted into the LLM’s input, so it reads biological data alongside text: ChatNT, CellWhisperer, BioReason and BioReason-Pro.
A foundation model scores a reasoning model’s answers during training, so its errors become part of the reward.
